operations.name: Streams.snapshot
operations.normalized_request: SnapshotRequest; route supplies operation=snapshot and project_id; absent limit20, absent cursornull; not a POST body.

operations.name: Streams.page
operations.normalized_request: ChangesRequest; route supplies operation=changes and project_id; absent limit20; cursorrequired; not a POST body.

query.limit: Canonical decimal1..50; identical resolved limit throughout snapshot and catch-up. No query/filter/order changes.
query.cursor: Issued unpadded base64url1..4096 chars, echo unchanged; possession never authorizes.

transport.authorization: One current trusted-host owner Bearer header; no browser/employee/remote-owner session.

authority.current_checks: Current registry owner, unrevoked Store coordinator, exact approved company/project and durable sole-owner room before protected lookup/cursor interpretation and final return. Another Alpha-authorized owner is denied.
authority.access_digest: Frozen History effective-access digest: current kind/stableprincipal/sortedpermissions/sortedproject_ids/Storeprincipal/owner-self audience/visibility policy; credential ID, fingerprint and expiry excluded.
authority.access_change: Current denial401/403 first; still-authorized changed effective access409 RESYNC_REQUIRED.
authority.unsupported_ABA: No durable access epoch. Unobserved remove/regrant under an alive issuer is unsupported; registry replacement requires a fresh listener.

durable_prerequisite.installation: Explicit trusted-host EventStore.install(company), existing service lease and one BEGIN IMMEDIATE; read/normalCLI never installs or adopts.
durable_prerequisite.storage: Additive immutable comms_stream_* tables/triggers in the same Store; Store user_version2 unchanged. No second DB/outbox worker/broker.
durable_prerequisite.coverage_floor: Validate every existing room accepted head and store immutable floor F with both historical anchors. No old public events/backfill. A future first room acceptance establishes F=0 atomically; missing floor for sequence>1 aborts.
durable_prerequisite.acceptance: AFTER private journal insertion is only the atomic hook: creates a separate UUIDv4 public event and fixed metadata, in the SAME acceptance transaction as room/revision/message/receipt/claim/journal. Hook failure rolls all back.
durable_prerequisite.public_identity: New durable event UUIDv4 + revision1 + visibility_revision1 + schema_version1; producer company_service/owner_discussion_acceptance/version1, event_type owner_discussion.message_stored. Scope-local sequence P=message.conversation_sequence-F. No raw global positions.
durable_prerequisite.exact_replay: Existing append replay creates no new acceptance/event. Stored immutable event identity/content stays stable across retries/reopens. Unique eventID/message/principal+command/room+P and predecessor guard fail conflicts/gaps.
durable_prerequisite.public_event_content: Exact accepted Conversation/Message typed refs/digests, stable principal/command/action/requestdigest, accepted millisecond timestamp, persistent stream_epoch, descriptive stored_record observation. EventItem wraps event + exact frozen ReadBack + digest. No private journal projection or actor authorization claim.

snapshot.atomic_bridge: One current-authorized BEGIN IMMEDIATE observes accepted history cut N and ledger coverage floor F, validates tail, captures both exact historical head anchors and public position W=N-F (+exact event_ref iff W>0). Concurrent commit is either within snapshot or strictly after W.
snapshot.baseline: Descending historical whole-record pairs fixed at N through1, including validated legacy baseline at/belowF. Every selected record aboveF must match a real covered public event. No current-head substitution.
snapshot.completion: Nonterminal: next_snapshot_cursor only, changes_cursornull. Terminal: complete_for_cut, next_snapshot_cursornull, changes_cursor atW. Apply the COMPLETE baseline before using that handoff; no replay from partial baseline.
snapshot.missing_room: 404 NOT_FOUND with no cursor/watermark/subscription. First acceptance then requires explicit fresh snapshot; no empty-unbound race promise.
snapshot.immutability: Same snapshot/head/floor/stream_epoch/anchors/limit/lifetime across baseline and catch-up. Later appends never shift baseline.
snapshot.no_public_legacy_interval: Legacy <=F is baseline-only, not public events; W0 means no covered event at that cut. Missing covered events/floors/anchors fail, never reset/adopt/skip.

catch_up.read: After-exclusive P from issued terminal-snapshot/changes cursor. Within one short transaction observe committed upper U and validate bounded indexed candidates throughU. No transaction waits on the client.
catch_up.range: after_position=inputP; nonempty start=P+1, contiguous event.sequence, end=last ACTUALLY emitted; idle startnull/endP; observed_through_position=U>=end. Snapshot watermark remains W<=P.
catch_up.completion: caught_up iff end==U, only through this response observation. Idle items[] is a read result, not a domain event or permission to poll. Later commits can exist afterU.
catch_up.continuation: Always next_cursor, positioned at emittedend (idleunchanged). Fixed query/limit/filter/order. No server consumption or ACK. Fixed lifetime never extended.
catch_up.retry: Repeating/discarding a response does not advance hidden state. An older cursor can return identical immutable event prefix PLUS newly committed tail/observed boundary. Whole response byte equality is not promised for open catch-up.
catch_up.projection: Apply identical eventID+revision+digest at most once. Reject conflicting sameidentity/version. Advance retained cursor only after whole schema/scope/range/ref/digest validation and successful local projection. Replay is data only: never append/start/task/approval/effect/model execution. No unbounded auto-fetch/polling required.

bounds.selection: Indexed same room/current owner/project sequences, limit+1; no totalCOUNT. Validate ALL selected candidates/lookahead before bytefit, so corruption cannot hide in omitted records.
bounds.encoding: Longest whole prefix whose complete signed canonical response INCLUDING escaping/envelope/allrefs/cursors fits262144; no item splitting/drop. Per EventItem fullcanonical65536. Error if even one whole selected item cannot fit.
bounds.coverage: Explicit partial with item_limit/byte_limit while observed unread records; none when complete/caughtup. total_count alwaysnull. Limits are supplemental checks, not inferred from character counts or Ajv.

lifetime.units: All public timestamps integer UTC epoch milliseconds. Snapshot issue/expiry fixed; observed_at is this read observation. Internal fixed monotonic deadline also enforced.
lifetime.checks: Before protected reads and before return; backwards-before-issue409; expired wall or monotonic410.

cursor_security.encoding: Opaque-to-client canonical unpadded base64url plus32byte HMACSHA256, NEW protocol domain; signature checked before closed strictJSON parse. Not confidentiality.
cursor_security.binding: Stable authenticated principal, company/project/room, fixed normalized limit/order/filter, current accessdigest, persistent stream_epoch/floor anchors, snapshotID/dualheadanchors/eventwatermark, fresh listenerincarnation, mode/nextposition, fixedwall+monoexpiry.
cursor_security.key: Fresh host-only32byte perlistener; never stored with records or serialized. No pertoken cache.
cursor_security.restore: Supported: STOP listener, offline existingStore restore, NEW listener/key/incarnation; oldcursor409 and explicit new snapshot. Stable covered accepted events in restored data remain unchanged.
cursor_security.unsupported: Live/in-place restore under an alive issuer, unobserved grantABA, generalized C17 restoreepoch/losslessrestore. Restore can roll back accepted data; do not splice/resume old projection or infer full recovery.

receiver_checks: Before awaiting credentials retain independently permitted company/project and resolved fixedlimit/query, then issued snapshot/cursor. Response echoes/cursor/principal prose never grant access.

Enforce strict rawoutput262144 and Unicode/integer/duplicate semantics with existing C01 canonicalization; command32768 stays separate. Validate closed schema, exact record/event/wrapper/page digests, descriptive observation and all nested scopes.

Snapshot: validate room_head independently, first message/Conversation fullrefs equal watermark; ranges descending contiguous, start initialN or priornext, terminalend1. Retain exact snapshot/room/floor/anchors acrosspages; no kind:id map collapsing revisions. Accumulate allbaseline beforeterminalhandoff.

Watermark W=N-F; eventrefnull iffW0; floor0 bothrefsnull, otherwise exacthistoricalanchor. Validate real eventref and EventItem ref+sequence/digest consistency. AcceptedCommand requestdigest reconstructed from response is INTERNAL consistency only, not independently retained append provenance.

Catch-up: require after=retainedposition, start=after+1 ifitems, contiguous scoped eventsequences and message.sequence=F+event.sequence, end=last; U>=end and caughtupiffendU. Do not accept gaps/duplicates/conflictingIDs or changing historicalrefs. Bind event.stream_epoch to retained snapshot.

Retain per-event identity/version/digest across retries, reject conflicts, project once and advance only after fullpage validation. An oldcursor replay may overlap; never execute commands from event/Message text.

On409/410 RESYNC_REQUIRED discard chain and explicitly create a fresh snapshot/projection; no auto-reset/splice/advance. Currentauthdenial withdraws access. Caller decides bounded explicit nextread, no model polling.

For nonnull snapshot watermark event_ref, reconstruct the fixed Event from its ID, snapshot epoch/W, retained watermark ReadBack full record refs, receipt action/principal/command/requestdigest, Message timestamp and frozen producer/schema/revision/visibility/observation; recompute its digest. This is INTERNAL consistency only, not a new delivery or independently retained append proof.

digests.canonicalization: Unchanged frozen C01 strictUnicode/safeinteger lexemes/explicitUTF16 keyordering/noUnicode normalization.
digests.preimages: For Event, EventItem and page: complete object excluding ONLY own top-leveldigest. Frozen nested Conversation/Message/Receipt/ReadBack preimages unchanged. EventRef is descriptive identity/ref, not separately signed.

error_body: Closed {schema_version:1,error:{code}} only; no reflected details.409 forged/foreign/mode/query/access/incarnation/lostanchor;410 verifiedexpiry;503missingcoverage/schema/corruption. A currentauthdenial wins before protectedcursorlookup.
proof_scope: Local synthetic existingStore + actual verifiedsamehostTLS snapshot/futureonlypullreplay. Not full C02/C03/C07, SSE, deliveryACKs, roomUI, remoteownersession, employee/model/native/account/cloud/pilot or fullcompany acceptance.
